name: Chee'ilth

abilityDetails.Cleanse: Bu etkiye sahip şampiyon bir debuff aldığında, debuff anında arındırılır ve Cleanse kaldırılır.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Grit: Unstoppable rakipler, vuruşlara sanki Unstoppable değillermiş gibi tepki verir.
abilityDetails.Tranquilize: Debuff yetenek doğruluğunu belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Vicious: Hasar veren debuff'ların gücünü belirtilen miktarda artırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Periyodik sanar bonusuyla sık purify eder, blok-nüfuzu var ve bloktan kritik vurabilir. Bloktan kanama da uygulayabilir — kanamaya immün/dirençli şampiyon önemli.
signatureAbility:
Xemamen (claw of The Bear)
Brother Grizzly extends his wisdom, granting a Precision Passive each time the Opponent is Immune to a Bleed effect, increasing Critical Rating by [447.67 - 1,480.76] for 10 seconds. While Chee'ilth has at least one of these Precision Passives, they can land Critical Hits through Block.
Sister Eagle also provides new assistance, instantly healing [55 - 90]% of all damage dealt to Chee'ilth by Physical Damage effects.

abilitySections.title: Oppose The One Below All
content: While fighting #Gamma Opponents, Chee'ilth's personal Debuffs gain 40% potency and her Synergy Bonuses gain special [Gamma] enhancements.

abilitySections.title: Personal Debuffs
content: As an Attacker, personal Debuffs gain 30% duration.
As a Defender, personal Debuffs can be inflicted through Block.

abilitySections.title: Spirit Charges - Max: 10
content: Every 20 seconds, Sister Eagle and Brother Grizzly bestow an indefinite Spirit Charge on Chee'ilth. As a Defender, this timer becomes 10 seconds.
When this timer expires, as well as at the start of each fight, Sister Eagle grants 2 indefinite Cleanse Passives. Max: 10.
Brother Grizzly grants +[175.53] Critical Damage Rating and +15% Bleed potency per Spirit Charge.

abilitySections.title: Sister Eagle the Healer - Blocking
content: While Blocking the Opponent's attacks, their Attack Rating is capped at 100% of what it was at the start of the fight.
Well-Timed Blocks reduce this Attack Rating cap to 50%. Each Well-Timed Block also shortens the Spirit Charge timer by 5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Brother Grizzly the Warrior - Attacking
content: Chee'ilth's Bleed Debuffs deal [5,492.55] Direct Damage over 9 seconds.
Striking the Opponent with the Adze Axe inflicts a Bleed Debuff.
Brother Grizzly shortens the Spirit Charge timer by 7 seconds each time Chee'ilth Punishes a Heavy Attack or Special Attack.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Punishing a Heavy Attack or Special Attack pauses all personal Debuffs on the Opponent for 5 seconds.
The final hit of this attack triggers 2 additional Bleed Debuffs.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation, gain a Grizzly's Grit Passive for 16 seconds which counts as a Grit Passive. While Grizzly's Grit is active, all attacks gain a 50% chance to inflict a Bleed Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final hit inflicts a non-stacking Eagle's Tranquilize Debuff for 12 seconds which counts as a 50% Tranquilize Debuff. While Eagle's Tranquilize is active, Chee'ilth cannot Miss. Each time a Debuff or Miss is prevented, pause Eagle's Tranquilize for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This attack can only be used once per fight.
Gain an indefinite 35% Vicious Passive.
Gain a 15 second Regeneration Buff, healing 50% of Health lost this fight or 30% of missing health, whichever is greater.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Xemamen (claw of The Bear)
content: Brother Grizzly extends his wisdom, granting a Precision Passive each time the Opponent is Immune to a Bleed effect, increasing Critical Rating by [447.67 - 1,480.76] for 10 seconds. While Chee'ilth has at least one of these Precision Passives, they can land Critical Hits through Block.
Sister Eagle also provides new assistance, instantly healing [55 - 90]% of all damage dealt to Chee'ilth by Physical Damage effects.
